name: NGC 4489 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4489, an early-type galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4489-hubble
story: NGC 4489 is one of 100 early-type galaxies in the Virgo Cluster that Hubble surveyed to study their globular star clusters, their shapes and their distances.

claims.text: The ACS Virgo Cluster Survey imaged 100 early-type galaxies in the Virgo Cluster
The survey's goals include globular clusters, galaxy isophotes (shapes) and distances
